$description: Camada GLASS — tokens de componente, por tema. Cada tema define seu par (opaco / glass). O app troca entre eles com [data-glass="on"]; nenhum componente lê valor cru. Regra de ouro: a superfície é translúcida, o texto NUNCA é — todo par surface/text mantém 4.5:1 medido sobre o fundo composto.

page-glow.brasa: radial-gradient(75% 55% at 22% -8%, rgba(92,16,26,.72), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(55% 45% at 96% 8%, rgba(255,69,12,.06), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(65% 55% at 108% 104%, rgba(70,12,20,.48), transparent 62%)
page-glow.dark-wine: radial-gradient(75% 55% at 22% -8%, rgba(146,26,40,.70), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(55% 45% at 96% 8%, rgba(200,232,74,.07), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(65% 55% at 108% 104%, rgba(122,21,32,.42), transparent 62%)
page-glow.wine: radial-gradient(75% 55% at 22% -8%, rgba(232,86,98,.16), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(65% 55% at 108% 104%, rgba(200,232,74,.12), transparent 62%)
